notes: Identity confirmed on four criteria in a single official line: CARE Hospitals' own per-doctor page is titled 'Dr Shravan Kumar Ch | Cardiology Doctor in Malakpet, Hyderabad | CARE Hospitals' - matching name (including the distinctive 'Ch' initial form), specialty (Cardiology), hospital (CARE) and branch (Malakpet) exactly as given in the workbook row. He also appears on three CARE Malakpet department/branch listing pages. Band is Medium, not High: all confirmations are carehospitals.com pages, which count as ONE official source; no independent official source (government registry, university, another hospital group) was found. Two searches were run and produced no email, phone, LinkedIn, personal website, Practo or Apollo247 profile - he has an unusually thin non-CARE footprint, consistent with an early-career consultant (5 years). NO PHONE RECORDED: a search summary offered CARE's group central line for CARE doctors generally; that is a switchboard, not his line, and was rejected per brief. A JustDial listing links a 'Dr. Shravan Kumar Ch' to Prathima Hospitals, Kachiguda - JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies and were not recorded, and this possible second attachment is unverified; a human may wish to check it. A search summary also claimed availability at several CARE branches (Banjara Hills, HITEC City, Musheerabad, Nampally, Malakpet) but only the Malakpet pages actually surfaced, so only Malakpet is asserted here. Beware of a distinct, similarly-named Hyderabad cardiologist 'Dr Sravan Kumar V' at Medicover Chandanagar and 'Dr Sravan Kumar Peravali' at Kondapur - both were seen in results and excluded; also distinct is 'Dr. Chinthala Shravan Kumar', a medical oncologist at Renova.
